Below is a list of the predefined callbacks that are available in `mlr3torch`.

The `Weight` column is what orders the callbacks within a training stage: a higher weight runs
later, and callbacks with the same weight keep the order they were passed to the learner. Custom
callbacks default to `0`, so this table is what to compare against when giving one a weight of its
own -- see the *Ordering* section of `CallbackSet`. Early stopping is not listed because it has no
dictionary entry; the learner builds it from its `patience` parameter, at weight 100.

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(mlr3torch)
content = as.data.table(mlr3torch::mlr3torch_callbacks)
content$key = sapply(content$key, function(key) sprintf("[%s](https://mlr3torch.mlr-org.com/reference/%s.html)", key, sub("mlr3torch::", "", t_clbk(key)$man)))
content$packages = lapply(content$packages, function(ps) setdiff(ps, "mlr3torch"))
content = content[, .(key, label, weight, packages)]
names(content) = c("Key", "Label", "Weight", "Packages")
knitr::kable(content)
```
